messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] get_attribute within a clone
parts:
Hi Bridget,

2017-11-09 3:47 GMT+01:00 Bridget Bassi <bbas...@gmail.com>:
> Hello,
>
> I am trying to set the timeout of a cloned trajectory based on a list. I was
> able to do so for the original, but it appears that attribute is only
> associated with the arrival and not with the clone? Is there any way to get
> around that? I want both clones to have the same index attribute, and it
> gets even more tricky because I would like to join this trajectory with a
> few others, and therefore cannot simply loop through a list- in case one
> arrival finishes a subtrajectory before the arrival that began before it.

Attributes are not being copied over to clones, and that's a bug. Good
catch! It's already solved on GitHub, so please install the package
from there to test it.

>
>
>
> Here's my code, the error is caused by the highlighted addition....
>
> j <- 0
> indexloop <- function() {
> if (j < length(arrivals$StartVector)+1) {
> j <<- j+1
> } else {
> j <<- 1
> }
> return(j)
> }
>
> t1 <- trajectory() %>%
> set_attribute("index", function() indexloop()) %>%
> clone(n = 2,
> trajectory("Original") %>%
> seize(resource = "resource1", amount = 1) %>%
> timeout(function () as.numeric(arrivals$Span1[get_attribute(env,
> "index")]))%>%
> release(resource = "resource1", amount = 1),
> trajectory("MW") %>%
> timeout(function() loop())%>%
> seize(resource = "resource2", amount = 1) %>%
> timeout(function () as.numeric(arrivals$Span2[get_attribute(env,
> "index")]))%>%
> release(resource = "resource2", amount = 1)) %>%
> synchronize(wait = TRUE, mon_all = FALSE)
>
>
> Thanks!
>
